email.subject: Bright Works Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Bright Works Dentistry's site. It isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button. Most dental searches happen on phones, often from people in pain who want to tap and call right away. Without a tap-to-call number, those calls likely go to a competitor's practice instead.

There's also no online booking, so anyone searching after hours has no way to grab a slot and may just move on.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's costing you calls?

Alex
Northlight Web
